This file compiles under `#pragma defer_codegen off`, where ordinary functions are emitted at parse time in source order -- the only measured lever that makes mwccarm emit D0 before D1 as the cartridge has them -- and this forcer is the parse-time trigger that places D0 first. Emitted between the licensed D0 and D1 sections. Homeless: config/ has no symbol row for it.
